# Changelog

This file records the compatibility port developed after the archived 0.7.1
release. The original changelog is preserved in
[`docs/legacy/CHANGELOG-0.7.1.txt`](docs/legacy/CHANGELOG-0.7.1.txt).

**Entry format:** auto-generated by `git-cliff` from commit messages (see
`cliff.toml`) - one bullet per commit, grouped by its `type:` prefix
(`feature`/`fix`/`tweak`/`docs`/`debug`/`refactor`/`chore`). Write the
actual wording in the commit message, not here - this file (and each
GitHub release's notes) are a mechanical render of it, not a second
drafting pass.
